name: 伙伴 GitHub
description: 显式选择伙伴 GitHub App 身份，操作指定 MontClip 仓库。Windows 使用 DPAPI，Linux 使用 Secret Service 加密保护凭据；不提供伙伴间强制身份隔离。
whenToUse: 伙伴通过自己的 GitHub App 操作各自获准仓库的 Issue、PR 和代码；ReviewInbox 可发 COMMENT、APPROVE、REQUEST_CHANGES 评审（主人 2026-11-15 决定）。

secretBindings.label: 伙伴 GitHub App 私钥（PEM）
secretBindings.hint: 只在设置页导入私钥时填写；导入后会自动清除。

tools.name: github_accounts
tools.description: 列出本机允许的 App 账号与凭据可读状态；名称标明预期/存储值，实时注册身份以 identity 回执为准。

tools.name: github_operations
tools.description: 读取可用操作及各操作参数格式；实际写操作前按该格式传参。

tools.name: github_import_key
tools.description: 按用户授权从明确的本机 PEM 文件导入 App 私钥；先验证真实 App 与安装范围，再由 Windows DPAPI 或 Linux Secret Service 加密保护。不要在参数中传私钥正文。

account.description: 伙伴账号别名；内置 bb/cindy/deja/dd/gg/jj/pg/qq/rea/video/vv/reviewinbox，另可在插件设置页添加新账号（如 ad）。

tools.name: github
tools.description: 使用显式App身份操作该 App 安装覆盖的仓库，权限以 GitHub 上的安装为准。先用github_operations查询参数；写入须对应用户任务授权。不会回退共享gh登录；未知结果先读回，勿重复写。

account.description: 伙伴账号别名；内置 bb/cindy/deja/dd/gg/jj/pg/qq/rea/video/vv/reviewinbox，另可在插件设置页添加新账号（如 ad）。

repo.description: good-night-oppie 下的仓库名（不带 owner）；能否使用由该 App 在 GitHub 上的安装决定，不在安装里返回 REPOSITORY_NOT_INSTALLED 且不执行。

tools.name: github_review_queue
tools.description: 自动评审队列：initialize只记录初始head；poll只读候选并对账；claim持有30分钟租约；finish必须验证真实review身份、head和标记。不得以完成标记替代真实评审。

tools.name: github_author_cue_plan
tools.description: 按BB规则计算作者提醒计划，不发送/不记录投递。输入须来自完整当前head快照及实际核验的承接来源；仅设置sourceVerified不足以证明核验。旧head、未到reportAt、重复cue抑制；归属不明交Deja，安全问题QQ。详见manual/author-cue-rules。

tools.name: inbox_service
tools.description: 管理插件拥有的隔离只读 Inbox 预览：启动、健康状态、停止。不会接管既有 Inbox，也不启用评审流水线。

items.name: agent-github
items.description: 伙伴身份选择、权限、PR评审及自动任务流程

items.name: oppie-github-work
items.description: Use a teammate's own Oppie GitHub App on the repositories its installation covers; inspect identity and diagnose installation, permission and repository scope failures before performing GitHub work.

releaseNotes: 2026-11-15: Plugin settings page to add teammate GitHub Apps (name, slug, App ID, installation ID, role, allowed operations) and repositories; changes take effect on the next call without restart. Every save shows a host confirmation card with the full change and uses a revision check; an audit line is recorded. App private keys are entered only in the settings page secret field, verified against GitHub and stored with the existing DPAPI store. Configured accounts can never be admin or use QQ-only operations; ReviewInbox review events are unchanged (owner decision 2026-11-15). Builds on the 1.5.0-preview.8-seven-roles.2 all-repositories fix. settings.2 (QQ review 2026-11-16): the configuration file is signed with a DPAPI-sealed HMAC key and revision, read through the owner-only ACL check, so hand edits, replays and deletions fail closed; the confirmation card lists who can write an added repository; leftover key copies are removed; whenToUse states the current ReviewInbox review events. settings.3 (DD, europa): deployment.json is read on every call instead of once at worker start, so host account and automaticReviews edits apply without a restart; an invalid deployment.json fails closed. settings.4 (QQ review of #33): automaticReviews is read only at worker start; deleting both the configuration and its key after a save is refused instead of reverting to defaults; identity and github_accounts report the configuration source. settings.5 (BB, #29 vs #33): configured accounts can allow a broader App installation (execution tokens still exact), request contents:read unless they can write contents, may use the new reviewer role (read, comment, any review event), and the owner can make a repository unusable for an account in the settings page (role none). settings.6 (owner via QQ, 2026-11-16): permissions follow the App's actual installation for every account; a broader installation is accepted automatically (the settings.5 per-account switch is removed); execution tokens request the least the operation needs (contents:read unless it writes contents) and must equal the request; a missing installation level fails with INSTALLATION_PERMISSION_MISSING naming what to add and where; identity reports installed and missing permissions. settings.7 (owner decision 2026-11-16, oppie-github#8: “plugin code must not box in teammates' permissions; the remote always wins”): what an account can do and which repositories it can use follow its GitHub App installation only. Removed from the plugin: roles, operation allowlists and ceilings, the repository list and per-repository roles, QQ-only and admin-only account limits (QQ can comment and write when its installation allows), and exact installation permission/repository checks. The settings page takes only the App identity (name, slug, App ID) and the private key; installation ID, permissions and repositories are read from GitHub when the key is imported and shown on the confirmation card, and every call looks the installation up again, so remote changes apply to the next call. Kept: per-operation execution tokens for the target repository only with exactly the operation's permissions (TOKEN_PERMISSION_MISMATCH otherwise), REPOSITORY_NOT_INSTALLED for a repository outside the installation, INSTALLATION_PERMISSION_MISSING naming what to add, keys only in the DPAPI store, no default-branch writes, no force push, owner authorization and host confirmation for rulesets, automaticReviews read only at start, signed configuration. settings.8 (Deja for #33, so the owner can give DejaOppieXYZ workflows:write for the merge_group change): an installation holding workflows:write still passes identity; update_file, edit_file and commit_files that touch .github/workflows/ ask the token for workflows:write too, and fail with INSTALLATION_PERMISSION_MISSING (details.workflowFiles, plain explanation and where to add it) when the installation lacks it. No other call asks for workflows. settings.9 (QQ's points on ADR #34, checked by Deja's request): upgrading does not stop anyone. A signed configuration saved by settings.2-6 still loads, its old repository and role fields ignored; an added account saved then keeps its installation ID only so its stored key stays readable (never used to choose the installation); a key that no longer matches its added account fails only that account (KEY_IMPORTED_FOR_OTHER_APP) instead of the whole key store. Tests show nothing is cached (a narrowed installation applies to the next call) and update_file to the default branch is refused before any file read. SCOPE-CONFIG.md documents the upgrade, caching and the identity output fields. settings.10 (QQ's approval of ADR #34, 5914736615 points 2 and 3): the repository name is resolved to its ID with a metadata-only token first (REPOSITORY_RESOLUTION_FAILED if it does not belong to good-night-oppie), and the execution token is requested by repository_ids only and must list exactly that ID. Writes to the default branch are refused from the resolved repository before the execution token. settings.11 (Deja 2026-11-16, ADR 0003 section 4: the confirmation cards for ruleset_update and admin_update stay): admin_update now needs a host confirmation card every time, for every account; without it the call fails with OWNER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED before the private key is read. It never had one before (it used to be limited to qq).
